availableCommands.name: antigravity-guide
availableCommands.description: Provides a comprehensive guide, quick reference, and sitemap for Google Antigravity (AGY), including the Antigravity CLI (agy), Antigravity 2.0, Antigravity IDE, Python SDK, slash commands, keybindings, and customizations (skills, rules, MCP, sidecars). Activate this skill when the user asks questions about how to use, configure, or customize Antigravity, AGY, the agy CLI, the Antigravity IDE, or Antigravity 2.0.

availableCommands.name: swarm
availableCommands.description: (Preview & Quota Heavy) Run a swarm: several agents working in parallel on one task, each in its own conversation, collaborating through a shared message board. Use when the work splits into pieces that can be done at the same time, or when a second pair of eyes should check the first pair's work.
